brief.headline: You're 1.36% of their sales — push for faster payment against a small price cut, and line up Gulshan or Tirupati as second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹63–64/KG (a 4–5% cut from ₹66.48/KG) in exchange for paying on delivery instead of 30 days later
priceAsk.basis: Our ₹66.48/KG sits in the market's typical band of ₹66–73/KG and well above the export reference of 42.95 ₹/kg. The market ask verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)', so there's room to move down a notch — especially if we solve their cash problem by paying earlier.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay on delivery (0 days) instead of 30 days after receipt, in return for the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days sooner frees up ₹1.24 Cr of our cash, but we trade that for a lower price that saves us money every month going forward

brief.financialLeverage: They keep only 2.3% of every ₹100 they sell as profit, and they owe 2.25 times their own cash (₹238.85 Cr in total debt). Their overall health score is D (21/100) — weak but not collapsing. We're 1.36% of their ₹1103.67 Cr revenue, so losing us would sting. Because they're cash-squeezed (high debt), they'll value getting paid faster — that's our trade: we pay now, they cut the price a bit to reflect the cash benefit to them.

evidence.point: We're a big customer to them
evidence.figure: Our ₹15.03 Cr is 1.36% of their ₹1103.67 Cr sales

evidence.point: They carry a lot of debt
evidence.figure: They owe 2.25x their own cash, totalling ₹238.85 Cr

evidence.point: Our price is market-fair but not the lowest possible
evidence.figure: We pay ₹66.48/KG; market typical band is ₹66–73/kg, and export reference is 42.95 ₹/kg

evidence.point: Paying them 30 days sooner ties up our cash
evidence.figure: Moving from 30 days to 0 days locks ₹1.24 Cr of our working capital

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — a much stronger drop-in alternate to Sayaji for dextrose

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller making Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade), exact form match; ₹365.39 Cr revenue, health D (27/100) — confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose), ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C (53/100) — growing capacity, credible second source

risks: Their health score is D (21/100) and debt is 2.25x equity — if we squeeze too hard on price, we risk destabilising a supplier who's already weak
We currently pay ₹66.48/KG, which is already the best price we get from anyone — so any cut will need a concrete give (faster payment) from us
Moving payment from 30 days to 0 days ties up ₹1.24 Cr of our cash — make sure the price saving pays back that cost within the year
All three alternates need qualifying (verify pharma-grade CoA, audit, get quotes) before we can credibly threaten to switch
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership — you're our sole source for Dextrose at ₹66.48/KG — but we'd like to talk about a deal where we pay you on delivery instead of in 30 days, and in return you help us get closer to the ₹60–64 range we're seeing in the market.
